description: Canonical JSON conformance vectors for srl.contracts.canonical (WP-B10). Each positive vector pairs an input (non-canonical key order where applicable) with exact expected canonical bytes. Each negative vector names the contract reason its input must be rejected with.

positive.name: v01-key-order
positive.description: Same object in a non-canonical key order canonicalizes to sorted-key bytes. Proves key-order independence.

positive.name: v02-unicode-nfc
positive.description: Non-ASCII (NFC) characters pass through as UTF-8 bytes, not \uXXXX escapes.

positive.name: v03-nested-empty
positive.description: Nested empty objects and arrays canonicalize compactly.

positive.name: v04-decimal-string
positive.description: A precision-sensitive value carried as a JSON string is preserved verbatim.

positive.name: v05-integer-bytes
positive.description: A non-negative integer byte count encodes as a bare integer.

positive.name: v06-deep-sorted
positive.description: Deeply nested object keys are sorted at every level.

positive.name: v07-array-order
positive.description: Array element order is preserved (sequences are NOT reordered).

positive.name: v08-null-bool-int
positive.description: null, bool, and int encode as distinct JSON tokens.

positive.name: v09-unicode-supplementary
positive.description: Supplementary-plane and multi-byte code points survive as UTF-8.

positive.name: v10-negative-decimal
positive.description: A negative decimal string is preserved verbatim.

positive.name: v11-empty-root
positive.description: An empty object root canonicalizes to '{}' plus newline.

positive.name: v12-safe-large-int
positive.description: A safe-range (2^53-1) large integer encodes exactly.

negative.name: n01-nan
negative.reason: NaN must be rejected by canonical JSON parsing.

negative.name: n02-infinity
negative.reason: Infinity must be rejected by canonical JSON parsing.

negative.name: n03-bool-as-int
negative.reason: A bool where an integer byte count is expected must be rejected.

negative.name: n04-self-hash
negative.reason: An object carrying its own object_id must be rejected as a self-hash.

negative.name: n05-absolute-path
negative.reason: An absolute path in a portable artifact ref must be rejected.

negative.name: n06-traversal-path
negative.reason: A '..' traversal path in a portable artifact ref must be rejected.

negative.name: n07-fractional-timestamp
negative.reason: A fractional-seconds timestamp must be rejected.

negative.name: n08-offset-timestamp
negative.reason: A non-UTC offset timestamp must be rejected.
